units.result_summary: Implemented Telethon client session configuration, MTProto authentication, and robust URL/entity parser for Telegram posts, stories, usernames, and channel IDs.
Implemented media download orchestrator for channel posts and story downloader with 24-hour window vs all-time filtering, preserving captions and timestamps.
Implemented Telegram bot interaction handlers and main CLI runner supporting --auth, --run, and --download modes.
Executed full TDD test suite with failing-first red phase and passing green phase verifying 16 test cases across all modules.

criterion_results.details: Telethon client config loads credentials and entity/link parser accurately extracts post, story, channel, and user identifiers.
Engine successfully fetches posts, photos, videos, stories with 24h filter and captures caption/date metadata.
Bot commands and incoming messages dispatch to the download engine and return download progress to user.
All unit tests pass verifying parsing, story time filtering, metadata extraction, and bot commands.

covered_code_task_tdd_evidence_requireme: Record failing-first evidence for the changed behavior before implementation or defect correction.
Record the green rerun that proves the targeted behavior passed after implementation.
Map the changed behavior to targeted verification evidence; generic suite success alone is insufficient.
If automated failing-first evidence is not appropriate, freeze and honor an explicit code-task TDD exception instead of silently skipping the requirement.
Do not create separate M/L/XL entry commands.
Do not introduce a second router or control plane.
tdd_evidence.notes: Red phase tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError before modules were created; green phase verified all 16 tests passing after implementation.
